meta.description: Knowledge graph of multi-domain repo: Drinks Store, RAF Marketplace, HR Database, ERP Flask System

edge_types.uses: Domain or component uses a technology
edge_types.contains: Domain contains a module or component
edge_types.manifests-in: Concept is embodied by this entity

nodes.label: Drinks Store App
nodes.description: Cross-platform beverage e-commerce app (iOS/Android/Web) using Expo + React Native. Direct-to-customer via WhatsApp. No backend required.

nodes.label: RAF Marketplace
nodes.description: Multi-vendor marketplace for Oman/GCC. 45-table PostgreSQL DB, FastAPI backend, 44 REST endpoints, 71 pytest tests, AI integration.

nodes.label: HR Database
nodes.description: Academic HR database design. 10-table star schema covering Employee lifecycle, org structure, and geographic hierarchy.

nodes.label: ERP Flask System
nodes.description: PLANNED: Full-stack ERP for import/distribution. 6 modules: HR, Accounting/GL, Inventory, Fleet, Sales, Purchasing.

nodes.label: Expo SDK 52
nodes.description: Framework for universal React apps targeting iOS, Android, and Web from one codebase.

nodes.label: React Native 0.76
nodes.description: Native mobile UI framework powering the Drinks Store app.

nodes.label: TypeScript 5.3
nodes.description: Static typing for JavaScript. Used across the Drinks Store frontend.

nodes.label: NativeWind/Tailwind
nodes.description: Tailwind CSS 3.4 adapted for React Native via NativeWind 4.1. Utility-first styling.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 16
nodes.description: Primary relational database for RAF. NUMERIC(14,3) for OMR currency, ENUM types, FK constraints, GIN indexes.

nodes.label: FastAPI
nodes.description: Python async web framework. 44 REST endpoints across 14 routers in RAF backend.

nodes.label: Python 3.11
nodes.description: Backend language for RAF Marketplace and planned ERP Flask system.

nodes.label: SQLAlchemy 2.0
nodes.description: Python ORM for RAF backend. Declarative models, async sessions. Also planned for ERP.

nodes.label: Alembic
nodes.description: Database migration tool for SQLAlchemy. 2 migrations in RAF (initial schema + reporting views).

nodes.label: Pydantic v2
nodes.description: Data validation for FastAPI request/response schemas.

nodes.label: Flask
nodes.description: Lightweight Python web framework planned for the ERP system.

nodes.label: pytest
nodes.description: Testing framework. 71 tests in RAF backend (auth, orders, payments, AI, shipping, returns).

nodes.label: Employee
nodes.description: Core HR entity: emp_id, emp_nm, email, hire_dt, edu_id (FK→Education).

nodes.label: Education
nodes.description: Education level lookup: edu_id, edu_level.

nodes.label: Job
nodes.description: Job title lookup: job_id, job_title.

nodes.label: Department
nodes.description: Department lookup: depart_id, depart_nm.

nodes.label: Location
nodes.description: Top-level geographic entity: loc_id, loc_nm. Root of HR geo hierarchy.

nodes.label: State
nodes.description: State within Location: state_id, state_nm, loc_id (FK→Location).

nodes.label: City
nodes.description: City within State: city_id, city_nm, state_id (FK→State).

nodes.label: Address
nodes.description: Address within City: addr_id, addr_nm, city_id (FK→City).

nodes.label: Salary
nodes.description: Salary lookup: salary_id, amount.

nodes.label: EmployeeStatus
nodes.description: Junction table: emp_id (FK), job_id (FK), manager_id, start_dt, end_dt, salary_id (FK). Many-to-many with metadata.

nodes.label: Identity & Auth
nodes.description: 7 tables: app_user, role, permission, role_permission, user_role, auth_session, activity_log. RBAC + 2FA + JWT.

nodes.label: Geography
nodes.description: 4 tables: country, region, city, address. Full address hierarchy for Oman/GCC.

nodes.label: Vendors
nodes.description: 3 tables: vendor, vendor_staff, vendor_wallet. Apply/approval workflow, commission-based payouts.

nodes.label: Catalog
nodes.description: 9 tables: category, brand, product, attribute, attribute_value, product_variant, variant_attribute, product_image, inventory.

nodes.label: Cart & Engagement
nodes.description: 4 tables: cart, cart_item, wishlist_item, review. Customer shopping and feedback.

nodes.label: Orders
nodes.description: 3 tables: customer_order, order_item, return_request. Full order lifecycle with status ENUM.

nodes.label: Payments
nodes.description: 4 tables: payment, refund, payout, wallet_transaction. Multi-gateway: Thawani, card, wallet, COD.

nodes.label: Shipping
nodes.description: 2 tables: shipment, shipment_event. Multi-carrier: Aramex, DHL, FedEx, local.

nodes.label: AI Layer
nodes.description: 5 tables: ai_job, ai_recommendation, ai_chat_session, ai_chat_message, ai_forecast.

nodes.label: Marketing
nodes.description: 2 tables: marketing_campaign, coupon. AI-generated campaigns, discount coupons.

nodes.label: Notifications
nodes.description: 2 tables: notification, device_token. Push, email, SMS channels.

nodes.label: app_user
nodes.description: Central user entity. user_status ENUM, soft deletes (deleted_at), audit timestamps.

nodes.label: product
nodes.description: Product catalog item. Bilingual name_ar/name_en, NUMERIC price, product_status ENUM.

nodes.label: customer_order
nodes.description: Order record linking user→vendor. order_status ENUM tracks 7 lifecycle stages.

nodes.label: payment
nodes.description: Payment record. payment_gateway ENUM (Thawani, card, wallet, COD).

nodes.label: vendor
nodes.description: Vendor entity. vendor_status ENUM (pending/approved/suspended), commission_rate NUMERIC.

nodes.label: inventory
nodes.description: Stock per product variant: quantity_available, quantity_reserved, low_stock_threshold.

nodes.label: ai_recommendation
nodes.description: AI-generated product recs. Links user + product, confidence_score, model_version.

nodes.label: coupon
nodes.description: Discount coupon. Percentage or fixed, per-vendor or platform-wide, max_usage_count.

nodes.label: CartContext
nodes.description: React Context for cart state: items[], total, count. add/remove/update/clear ops. Persists via AsyncStorage.

nodes.label: ProductCard
nodes.description: UI card: product image, name, price + QtyStepper. Add-to-cart button.

nodes.label: PRODUCTS Data
nodes.description: Static catalogue: 100+ drinks in 9 categories. Product + Category TypeScript types.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Flow
nodes.description: buildOrderMessage() + buildWhatsAppUrl() + sendOrderToWhatsApp(). Cart → formatted WhatsApp message.

nodes.label: RTL Layout
nodes.description: Root layout: lang=ar, dir=rtl, Cairo Google Font. NativeWind RTL utilities.

nodes.label: RBAC
nodes.description: Role-Based Access Control. 4 roles: customer, vendor_owner, vendor_staff, admin. Granular permission table with role_permission mapping.

nodes.label: Bilingual AR/EN
nodes.description: Arabic-first multilingual support. RAF: *_ar/*_en columns. Drinks: full RTL Arabic UI. ERP: Arabic accounting labels. Shared across 3 domains.

nodes.label: Soft Deletes
nodes.description: Records marked deleted_at (nullable timestamp) instead of physical deletion. Preserves audit history. RAF-wide pattern.

nodes.label: Audit Trail
nodes.description: created_at + updated_at on every RAF table. activity_log table tracks user actions with IP, user agent, payload.

nodes.label: Multi-vendor
nodes.description: Multiple independent vendors on one platform. Per-vendor catalogues, wallets, staff, commission rates, approval workflow.

nodes.label: 2FA / TOTP
nodes.description: TOTP-based two-factor authentication. pyotp library, QR code setup, enable/disable endpoints.

nodes.label: AI Integration
nodes.description: 5 AI capabilities: product generation, personalized recommendations, demand forecasting, chat assistant, image processing.

nodes.label: WhatsApp Checkout
nodes.description: Stateless zero-backend order flow: cart → formatted message → vendor WhatsApp. Unique approach for local commerce.

nodes.label: Cart Persistence
nodes.description: Cart state survives app restarts via AsyncStorage. Works on mobile (SQLite) and web (localStorage).

nodes.label: Geographic Hierarchy
nodes.description: Location→State→City→Address (HR). Country→Region→City→Address (RAF). Same 4-level pattern, independently designed in both domains.

nodes.label: Employee Lifecycle
nodes.description: Hire date, job assignments via junction table, manager relationships, salary tracking. HR DB → ERP HR module.

nodes.label: Order Lifecycle
nodes.description: 7-stage flow: cart→order→payment→shipment→delivery→(return)→(refund). Status ENUM at each stage.

nodes.label: HR & Payroll
nodes.description: PLANNED. Employee management, payroll calculation, salary advances. Extends HR Database concepts.

nodes.label: Accounting / GL
nodes.description: PLANNED. Chart of Accounts (COA) with Arabic labels, journal entries, double-entry bookkeeping.

nodes.label: Inventory Module
nodes.description: PLANNED. Stock movements, transfers, goods receipts, low-stock alerts, barcode scanning.

nodes.label: Fleet Management
nodes.description: PLANNED. Vehicle master, route planning, load orders, delivery tracking, maintenance logs.

nodes.label: Sales & Purchasing
nodes.description: PLANNED. Sales invoices, AR aging, purchase orders, goods receipts, Excel/PDF export.

nodes.label: App Factory
nodes.description: Flask/FastAPI app factory pattern. Configures app from settings, registers routers/blueprints. Used in RAF; planned for ERP.

nodes.label: Service Layer
nodes.description: Business logic in services/ (AI provider, vendor access, coupons, notifications). Keeps HTTP routers thin and testable.

nodes.label: Context API
nodes.description: React Context API for global state. CartProvider wraps the app; useCart() hook for consumers.

nodes.label: Junction Table
nodes.description: Many-to-many bridge with metadata. EmployeeStatus resolves Employee↔Job with dates + salary. Also role_permission, variant_attribute in RAF.
